checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Reads KwickFixx with correct capitals and two lowercase x.

must.item: Name legible and not obscured by the mark
must.why: The wrench sits at the upper right and slightly touches the last x, but the name is clear.

must.item: Small orange wrench with black lettering
must.why: A small orange wrench sits beside bold black text.

must.item: White background, no slogan or extra text
must.why: The background is white (slightly off-white) and there is no other text.

faults.what: The wrench is very close to or touching the last x, and it is tiny and crammed at the edge. The lockup is cramped and the text sits near the left edge.
The background looks very slightly off-white or gray.

summary: A clean square logo with bold black "KwickFixx" spelled correctly and a small orange wrench on white; the only issue is the wrench is cramped against the last x.
